name: complete-domain-stays-complete
label: A complete domain stays complete
comment: A domain that has reached zero on its own checks stays at zero. The domains this rule holds are the ones its appliesTo names; adding a domain is an edit to this row. For each named domain the check runs that domain's own lint (policy-validate --domain <name> --own) and every violation it prints is one violation here. Jeff 2026-11-21: principles is the first complete domain; 2026-11-23: finish principles (#5033).
